protocol: Disc-fix posts proposed_change + evidence. Matrix runs phases and posts verdict pass|fail. Next patch only after pass. Simple English.

proposed_change.summary: Unbundled R3 only: harden eeaddr1 readee length fields in read_to_ee so AlignReadBuffer sees counts when dest1/dest2 are fed; keep payload→readee→curReadPos→complete_call order; keep evidence logs. No sceCdSync wake (R4). No WaitSema rewrite (R2). No CNK hacks.
details: When read_to_ee copies a sector into dest1 (or dest2), also write the matching length at readee+0 / +4 (today dests are restored after memset but lengths stay 0).
For unaligned dst (Hitman example 0x52C098), populate readee head/tail length+payload the Sony way so AlignReadBuffer can finish copy-out.
Keep existing curReadPos write before complete_call (already proven correct).
Keep g_trace_hle complete_after_read / eeaddr lines for matrix.
Do NOT call cdvd.cpp finish_read / sceCdSync waiter wake (that is R4).
Do NOT change WaitSema/iSignalSema or host_signal(2).
Do NOT touch CNK virt-LBA / host_signal 16/54/55 / soft-arm / FCE0 / +24008.
proposed_change.success_bar: Both games still reach frame limit with prims moving; no Alchemy; graphics/settings menu untouched; leftover WaitSema 2 may remain (R2 ownership).

curReadPos_proven.hitman: 35/35 complete_after_read lines: curReadPos equals expect (e.g. @0x54E480=2048 expect 2048)
curReadPos_proven.order: payload+readee+curReadPos happen inside read_to_ee BEFORE sif::complete_call

remaining_gap.readee_lengths: After memset, dest1/dest2 restored but b1len/b2len left 0 even when dest1 is fed — AlignReadBuffer can see dest with zero length
remaining_gap.unaligned: Hitman complete_after_read dst=0x52C098 (unaligned) — needs readee head/tail fields
remaining_gap.huge_N_0xE: Not a read bug: N 0xE is DiskReady (immediate ret 2); garbage sector/count args are probes, not 322609-sector reads

evidence.r2_note: Leftover WaitSema 2 stays ownership/observe — not claimed fixed by R3

discfix.files_touched_note: Diagnostic-only fprintf under g_trace_hle already landed for evidence; behavioral R3 patch waits for matrix pass

matrix.notes: Disc-fix cycle 3: unbundled R3_readee_length_harden. R1 cleared. No R4. Waiting for matrix.

quarantine: Never apply CNK Alchemy host_signal 16/54/55, soft-arm, FCE0 force, virt-LBA, or +24008 hacks to Hitman/NFS. Never host_signal(2).
commit_policy: No commits until stable build; then commit freely.
